title: Oglesby Mansion

services.name: Quilt Exhibit
services.desc: The Governor Oglesby Mansion and Museum at 421 West William in Decatur’s historic district invited the talented members of the Decatur Quilters Guild to display some of their quilts in the patterns of Governor Oglesby’s time at the Mansion. The guild has twenty-one quilts on exhibit during the August Open Houses at the Mansion. Visitors will see various patterned quilts displayed throughout the Museum’s exhibit space. Each quilt is labeled with the pattern and additional details. The quilt exhibit is on display each Wednesday and Saturday in August from 2-4 as well as Sunday, August 30th. “The quality of the quilt exhibit is exquisite,” says Dave Davis, board chairman of the Oglesby
